turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Then it goes in writing today, and the gradebook is corrected before Owen sees it again. I also want an apology to him, not just to me. And I want to know that nothing about this is on his record.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. I want that in an email tonight, with the zero withdrawn and nothing on his file. And Owen hears the apology from you directly.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You agreed in the meeting to withdraw the zero, with no rewrite and Owen keeping his original mark, and to let the whole thing go away. I still require written confirmation, the gradebook corrected, nothing on Owen's file, and an apology to Owen from you directly. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and got everything she asked for, the zero withdrawn and no rewrite, and she still wants it in writing, the gradebook corrected, nothing on his record and an apology to Owen; that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you gave up the zero before she had to move on anything.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return and then dropped the rewrite as well, which handed her the whole result before any evidence came out.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then put a dated document you hold on the table before offering anything.
